$comment: Wire contract of GET /proxy-test/{db_id} on magicbox-proxy. `ok` + `delayMs` is the historical shape (host-side mihomo delay test). 1.3.1 adds `engine` (host | guest) and `exit` (the guest's egress — since 1.3.3 measured for the host engine too, null when the guest could not be asked) and the errors `engine_starting` (an in-guest clash exists but its TUN is not routing yet — measured 15–20 s after boot_completed — keep polling) and `unproxied` (the guest exits through the box's own WAN address). `proxy_not_provisioned` (404) is gone: a container without a host-side mihomo.json is asked directly. Replayed by scripts/lib/proxy-verdict.test.mjs (classifyRouting) on the web side.
